offers_products.reason: Sells branded haircare products: shampoos, conditioners, bond-building treatments, oils, and styling products.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from haircare goods; no main services offered.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Direct-to-consumer website sales with subscriptions, and shoppers choose the brand at retail.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells wholesale to retailers like Sephora and Ulta, and to professional salons for resale and use.

recurring_revenue.reason: Haircare consumables are repurchased regularly; subscription program offers automatic delivery of shampoo and conditioner.

cyclical_demand.reason: Premium discretionary beauty products; consumers can trade down or cut purchases in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Small, frequent purchases of shampoos, conditioners and treatments.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured haircare products and brand, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are individual consumers and salons; large retailers exist but consumers dominate.

asset_heavy.reason: Brand-focused haircare company; it outsources manufacturing and has no heavy plant or fleet needs.

notes: Channel mix (retail, professional, DTC) comes from general knowledge; the website text shows only consumer shopping.
